scripts.rag: cd "RAG PROCESS" && set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 && uvicorn main:app --port 8001
scripts.backend: cd "BACKEND PROCESS" && set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 && uvicorn main:app --port 8000
scripts.start: concurrently -n "RAG,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm run rag" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
